notes.AGO: 父母同意時女 15、男 16 歲。
notes.ARE: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.BDI: 父母同意時女 18、男 21 歲。
notes.BHR: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.BHS: 父母同意 15 歲；法院許可 13 歲。
notes.BRN: 穆斯林的婚姻女性要監護人同意。
notes.CAN: 各省不同（18–19 歲）；父母同意 16 歲。
notes.CMR: 父母同意時女 15、男 18 歲。
notes.ETH: 各地不同；索馬利州 15 歲。
notes.FSM: 父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲。
notes.GBR: 各地不同；英格蘭與威爾斯 18 歲；蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭 16 歲。
notes.HTI: 父母同意時女 15、男 18 歲。
notes.IND: 男性 21 歲；穆斯林依個人法 15 歲。
notes.IRN: 男性 18 歲；父母同意時女 13、男 15 歲。
notes.JOR: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.KAZ: 父母同意 17 歲；法院許可 16 歲。
notes.KWT: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.LBR: 男性 21 歲；父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲。
notes.LBY: 各地不同；女性要監護人同意；男性西部 18 歲、東部 20 歲。
notes.LSO: 父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲。
notes.MLI: 男性 18 歲；法院許可 15 歲。
notes.MRT: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.MYS: 民事婚姻 21 歲（父母同意女 16、男 18 歲）；穆斯林的婚姻女性要監護人同意。
notes.NER: 父母同意時女 15、男 18 歲。
notes.NGA: 各州不同：南部多數州 18 歲，夸拉、阿夸伊博姆 16 歲，北部實施伊斯蘭法的州沒有規定（青春期）。
notes.OMN: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.PAK: 各省不同：旁遮普、信德 18 歲，其他地區女性 16 歲；男性 18 歲。
notes.PNG: 父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲；法院許可 14 歲。
notes.PSE: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.QAT: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.SAU: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.SDN: 穆斯林的婚姻沒有年齡規定（青春期）；其他婚姻男 18、女 16 歲。
notes.SEN: 父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲。
notes.SOM: 女性不論幾歲都要監護人同意，取男性的年齡。
notes.SWZ: 父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲。
notes.TKL: 男性 21 歲；父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲。
notes.TUR: 父母同意 17 歲；法院許可 16 歲。
notes.TWN: 民法第 980 條，2023 年 1 月 1 日起男女都是 18 歲（同年成年年齡也降到 18 歲）。
notes.TZA: 父母同意時女 15、男 18 歲；法院許可 14 歲。
notes.UGA: 民事婚姻 21 歲（父母同意 18 歲）；穆斯林的婚姻女性要監護人同意。
notes.USA: 多數州 18 歲；內布拉斯加 19 歲、密西西比 21 歲。
notes.VUT: 父母同意時女 16、男 18 歲。
notes.YEM: 沒有女性的最低年齡（要監護人同意）；男性 15 歲。
notes.ZAF: 父母同意時女 15、男 18 歲。

notesEn.AGO: 15 for women and 16 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.ARE: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.BDI: 18 for women and 21 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.BHR: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.BHS: 15 with parental consent; 13 with judicial consent.
notesEn.BRN: Muslim women need a guardian’s consent.
notesEn.CAN: Varies by province (18–19); 16 with parental consent.
notesEn.CMR: 15 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.ETH: Varies by region; 15 in Somali Region.
notesEn.FSM: 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.GBR: Varies by region; 18 in England and Wales; 16 in Scotland and Northern Ireland.
notesEn.HTI: 15 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.IND: 21 for men; 15 for Muslims under personal law.
notesEn.IRN: 18 for men; 13 for women and 15 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.JOR: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.KAZ: 17 with parental consent; 16 with judicial consent.
notesEn.KWT: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.LBR: 21 for men; 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.LBY: Varies by region; Women need a guardian’s consent; for men 18 in the west and 20 in the east.
notesEn.LSO: 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.MRT: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.MYS: 21 for civil marriages (16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent); Muslim women need a guardian’s consent.
notesEn.NER: 15 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.NGA: Varies by state: 18 in most southern states, 16 in Kwara and Akwa Ibom, puberty in the northern sharia states.
notesEn.OMN: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.PAK: Varies by province: 18 in Punjab and Sindh, 16 for women elsewhere; 18 for men.
notesEn.PNG: 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent; 14 with judicial consent.
notesEn.PSE: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.QAT: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.SAU: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.SDN: No minimum age (puberty) for Muslim marriages; 18 for men and 16 for women in other marriages.
notesEn.SEN: 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.SOM: Women need a guardian’s consent at any age; the age for men is shown.
notesEn.SWZ: 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.TKL: 21 for men; 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.TUR: 17 with parental consent; 16 with judicial consent.
notesEn.TWN: Civil Code, Article 980: 18 for both men and women since 1 January 2023, when the age of majority also became 18.
notesEn.TZA: 15 for women and 18 for men with parental consent; 14 with judicial consent.
notesEn.UGA: 21 for civil marriages (18 with parental consent); Muslim women need a guardian’s consent.
notesEn.USA: 18 in most states; 19 in Nebraska and 21 in Mississippi.
notesEn.VUT: 16 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
notesEn.YEM: No minimum age for women (a guardian’s consent is needed); 15 for men.
notesEn.ZAF: 15 for women and 18 for men with parental consent.
